sub: Make an access request an application was denied for you, and follow the requests about you. Approving is for the people the realm's policy names. An approval does not grant anything by itself: the application asks again, and the realm's policy decides.
off: The hosted access request form is turned off in this realm.
noneMine: There is no access request about you.
asks: An application was denied this access for you, and it can be requested:
subject: For
durationLongest: As long as the policy allows
emergency: This is an emergency: ask for emergency access now. It needs a justification and is reviewed afterwards.
status: {status, select, pending {It is waiting for an approver.} approved {It is approved. The application can ask again now.} denied {It was denied.} expired {Nobody decided it before it expired.} cancelled {It was cancelled.} failed {It could not be completed.} other {It is {status}.}}
made: {origin, select, form {You made this request here on {when}.} other {The application made this request on {when}.}}
submitted: {status, select, approved {Your access request is approved. The application can ask again now.} other {Your access request is sent. An approver decides it.}}
